rationale: Thomas brings deep ML applications expertise as a Staff AI Scientist at Intuit, while Karen is actively working on mechanistic interpretability research and building AI tooling—complementary angles on the same ML landscape. Karen's hands-on experience with Python, C++, and hardware (Verilog) paired with Thomas's production AI experience could surface useful perspectives on moving research toward real-world systems.
intro_message: Thomas, meet Karen Mkrtchyan — she's doing mechanistic interpretability research and AI tooling at USC and codes in Python, C++, and Verilog; you might find her work-in-progress interesting given your applied ML background at Intuit.
